cards.title: Would more hands-on dads create a more peaceful world?
cards.body: Scientist Sarah Blaffer Hrdy has rewritten evolutionary science to challenge Darwinian sexism. Now she's exploring how involved fatherhood could reshape society and family dynamics.

cards.title: Parents: please don't buy Grand Theft Auto VI for your child
cards.body: Rockstar Games' 18-rated game is stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence. It's the most graphic game available and absolutely not appropriate for children.

cards.title: My son's back home – and my mothering skills gone
cards.body: A graduate has returned to the nest due to economic pressures, forcing parents to readjust. The extended holiday phase has shifted into an uncertain longer-term arrangement.

cards.title: My ideal man? I'll take a carer over adventurer
cards.body: Parents face difficult questions about leaving small children to pursue personal adventures. The article explores whether it's acceptable to abandon family responsibilities for self-discovery.

cards.title: Egg Donation: Is It Private, or a Secret?
cards.body: Parents must navigate complex questions about disclosure when using egg donation. Understanding the difference between privacy and secrecy is crucial for children's wellbeing.

cards.title: My Kid Wants to Play Grand Theft Auto. Now What?
cards.body: Parents need guidance on handling the new GTA VI release and its controversial content. Expert advice helps navigate conversations about age-appropriate gaming.

cards.title: Talking to Youth About Online Gambling and Sports Betting
cards.body: Sports betting commercials create perfect teaching moments for parents to discuss gambling risks. Open conversations help youth understand the dangers of prediction markets.

cards.title: Tips for Newly Divorced Co-Parents Around the Holidays
cards.body: The first year after divorce is particularly challenging when children are involved. Holiday seasons require extra planning and emotional management for co-parenting families.

cards.title: Are Your Sons the Casualties of a Gender-Based Reading Crisis?
cards.body: Boys are falling behind in reading engagement, requiring targeted motivation strategies. Parents play a crucial role in fostering lifelong reading skills in sons.

cards.title: How to Cope With the Season of Family-Focus
cards.body: Year-end holidays can be emotionally difficult for those struggling to build families. Parents and those without children need support navigating family-centered cultural messaging.
